_comment: Read-only verification config for the IWA STRK20 demo. No key material and no account belong in this file. Secrets are supplied via environment variables only (see lib/secrets.mjs).
_privacy_pool: VERIFIED StarkWare STRK20 privacy pool. IWA integrates with it and must never declare or deploy it.
_usdc_token: VERIFIED Circle native USDC on Starknet (symbol USDC, decimals 6). NOT bridged USDC.e.
_strk_token: VERIFIED STRK (decimals 18). Also the token the pool collects its fee in.
_surplus_sink: Immutable 5th constructor argument of the deployed IwaStrk20Helper. The preflight asserts the on-chain helper still reports exactly this address.
_circle: Demo circle terms. memberLimit >= 2 is a contract rule (create_circle rejects 1). contributionAmount is in USDC base units (6 decimals): 1000000 = 1.00 USDC.
